newsitem.title: UK: EUROPE CRUDE OIL AND DISTILLATE STOCKS UP IN JULY.
newsitem.headline: EUROPE CRUDE OIL AND DISTILLATE STOCKS UP IN JULY.

text.p: Crude oil and middle distillates stocks rose in the 15 countries of the European Union plus Norway during July, according to the latest monthly report from Stitching Euroilstock.
But other oil product stocks fell, the report issued on Tuesday said.
Middle distillates rose 2.40 million barrels to 316.05 million during July from June's level.
Middle distillates stocks stood 3.5 percent above year earlier levels at the end of July, said Stitching Euroilstock.
Crude oil stocks also rose, climbing 2.26 million barrels to 418.29 million in July.
But other oil product stocks fell. Heavy fuel stocks fell 3.77 million barrels or 2.5 percent to 140.79 million barrels in July.
Gasoline fell 2.46 million to 156.49 million barrels in July while naphtha stocks fell 0.88 million barrels or 3.5 percent to 24.20 million barrels.
Only middle distillates and naphtha stocks stood above year ago levels at the end of July, 3.5 percent and 8.4 percent respectively.
Crude oil stocks were one percent under year earlier levels while fuel was 5.3 percent below and gasoline 6.8 percent below.
A full inventory list, including country-by-country data, in barrels and tonnes, is on Reuters pages EUROILA to EUROILJ.
